description: Error contract for CMP-1112-D2-04 (hand-off to Dev 4). Each case: a bad tool call -> the exact envelope Compass returns. Format confirmed by Dev 1 on 11/25 (Q4: the guide's JSON envelope; Q5: transaction IDs reused + result_id).

_notes.envelope: Always exactly {error, tool, message, details}. details is a list of {loc, msg, input}; [] when there is no field-level detail.
_notes.loc: Path to the bad field as a list: ["limit"], ["period", "start"]. [] means the whole input (e.g. broken JSON). ["period"] alone means a rule across start and end.
_notes.msg: Human text. For invalid_tool_arguments it comes from Pydantic; show it, don't parse it. Branch on error and loc instead.
_notes.input: What the model actually sent for that field, unchanged.
_notes.needs_db: true = args are valid; the failure comes from the database (run through call_tool on the synthetic DB).
